name: gravity-drop-trail
description: 鼠标跟随重力弹跳图片瀑布
interaction: Images cascade from the cursor position, each one subject to simulated gravity and elastic bouncing as they collide with the viewport floor. The mouse acts as a continuous emitter — move it to redirect the waterfall, creating organic piles and scatter patterns of tumbling visuals. Every piece responds to physics in real time, turning casual cursor movement into a mesmerizing kinetic sculpture.
